p: fire came down from heaven: By this God declared that he was pleased with Solomon's prayer.
the feast seven days: The feast of the tabernacles which was kept in the seventh month.
made a solemn assembly: They assembled to hear the word of God, after they had remained seven days in the booths or tabernacles.
three and twentieth day of the: They had permission to depart on the 22nd day, 1Ki 8:66 but they did not leave till the next day.
heal their land: I will cause the pestilence to cease and destroy the beasts that hurt the fruit of the earth, and send rain in due season.

sanctified for my name: Declaring that God had more concern for their salvation than for the advancement of his own glory: and where men abuse those things which God has appointed to set forth his praise, he withdraws his graces.
